_comment: Continue Kromoss (lodestones/Kromoss = sft_base_v2's update-2000 EMA) with the same recipe on the 4x RTX PRO 6000 PCIe box (96 GB, no NVLink, two sockets). parallelism zero: ZeRO-1 (utils/zero_sharding.py), Muon/AdamW state and the fp32 EMA owned whole per rank (~1/4 each), grads reduced to owners once per update, owners broadcast; train_sft sets NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS (cross-socket P2P ~18 GB/s vs ~3.4 GB/s staged through host). 4 GPUs x 2 x accum 8 = 64 images/update as before. Fresh optimizer state (the release ships EMA weights only), so a short 50-update warmup. Images from the local rustfs mirror via file_path (Backblaze urls 404 on extensionless rows). grad_checkpoint 30 (sweep, 4 GPUs, accum 4: 42 -> 71 GiB 12.8 s/update, 30 -> 85 GiB 12.2 s, 24 -> 93 GiB 12.0 s); per update the ZeRO sync costs ~1.5-2 s reduce (incl. rank skew) + 1.3 s broadcast + 0.6 s step, ~17% at accum 8.
